title: Connected TV Ads in the UK - The TV Agency

facts.fact: The TV Agency states that over 45 million people in the UK use CTV devices to watch shows and movies.
facts.quote: with over 45 million people using CTV devices to watch their favourite shows and movies

facts.fact: The TV Agency states that Sky Go has over 12 million registered users.
facts.quote: With over 12 million registered users, this platform has an active and engaged audience.

facts.fact: The TV Agency states that the most common CTV pricing model, CPM, can start from £15 and go up to £50+.
facts.quote: The most common though is still CPM which can start from £15 going up to £50+.

facts.fact: In the TV Agency's illustrative example, a £15 CPM with a £20k budget could reach 1,333,333 viewers.
facts.quote: A £15 CPM with a 20k budget could reach 1,333,333 viewers!

facts.fact: In the TV Agency's illustrative example, a £25 CPM with a £20k budget could reach 800k viewers.
facts.quote: A £25 CPM with a 20k budget could reach 800k viewers!

facts.fact: In the TV Agency's illustrative example, a £35 CPM with a £20k budget could reach 571k viewers.
facts.quote: A £35 CPM with a 20k budget could reach 571k viewers!

facts.fact: In the TV Agency's illustrative example, a £50 CPM with a £20k budget could reach 400k viewers.
facts.quote: A £50 CPM with a 20k budget could reach 400k viewers!

facts.fact: The TV Agency says a regional CTV test campaign could easily cost less than £10k, while a much larger national campaign could easily cost £50k or more.
facts.quote: A regional test campaign could be easily less than 10k but a much larger national campaign could easily be 50k plus.

facts.fact: The TV Agency states that ITVX works on a cost-per-thousand-impressions (CPM) model.
facts.quote: Plus, it works on a cost-per-thousand-impressions (CPM) model

facts.fact: The TV Agency states that Sky Advance, Sky's programmatic advertising platform, works on a CPM basis.
facts.quote: It also works on a CPM basis, making it a cost-effective choice for advertisers.
